reason: The raw ordinal score and its own-presence times conditional-ordinal reconstruction can differ by floating-point rounding. Distinct conditional ordinal values can also yield identical FP32 products after multiplication by the receiver's own presence. A reconstruction-only difference must not count as actual composition consumption or a mechanism response.
prospective_authorization: Root approved this exact numerical-null safeguard before ordinal training launch and before any final ordinal endpoint mechanism predictions; root separately freezes the files and records the execution state.

definitions.f32: Round to the IEEE-754 binary32 value at each explicitly stated operation; no fitted tolerance, epsilon or quantitative change threshold.
definitions.u_own: f32(ordinal(r_own)), with the same existing FP32 conditional-ordinal computation
definitions.u_donor: f32(ordinal(r_donor)), with the same existing FP32 conditional-ordinal computation
definitions.normal_c: The exact FP32 raw ordinal score normally consumed by the unchanged trained model

override_rule.undefined_own_or_donor_conditional_compo: Keep exact normal_c and mark unsupported/null under the original zero-nonempty-mass rule; no uniform fallback.
override_rule.if_u_own_equals_u_donor_OR_self_product_: Keep exact normal_c, even when normal_c differs from self_product by reconstruction rounding.
override_rule.actual_condition_change: Compare the final supplied FP32 override directly with exact normal_c, as in the parent protocol. A preserved numerical null cannot count toward the changed-score support requirement.

required_reporting: whether exact normal_c was preserved due to equal conditional score or equal FP32 product
all fixed donor mappings, actual supplied scores and unsupported/null reasons
required_verification: A synthetic fixture must contain distinct FP32 conditional ordinals whose receiver-presence products are exactly equal, with exact normal_c differing from self_product; the repaired override must equal exact normal_c and must not count as a condition change. Existing same-u, zero-mass, multiset, stratum, support and effect-gate checks remain required.
interpretation: This is a prospective numerical-null correction to a diagnostic intervention, not an additional scientific candidate, relaxed success gate or performance-selected amendment.
